definitions.explanation: Two months from the current month.

examples.japanese: {再来月|さらいげつ}に{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}します。
examples.english: I'm moving the month after next.

examples.japanese: {結婚式|けっこんしき}は{再来月|さらいげつ}です。
examples.english: The wedding is the month after next.

examples.japanese: {再来月|さらいげつ}から{新|あたら}しい{仕事|しごと}を{始|はじ}める。
examples.english: I'll start a new job from the month after next.

examples.japanese: {再来月|さらいげつ}は{何|なに}も{予定|よてい}がないから、ゆっくり{休|やす}みたい。
examples.english: I have no plans the month after next, so I want to relax.

examples.japanese: {再来月|さらいげつ}に{両親|りょうしん}が{外国|がいこく}から{来|く}るので、{今|いま}から{準備|じゅんび}を{始|はじ}めている。
examples.english: My parents are coming from abroad the month after next, so I've started preparing now.

notes:
{再来月|さらいげつ} means the month after next.

WORD FORMATION:
{再|さ} (again) + {来|らい} (coming) + {月|げつ} (month)

MONTH SEQUENCE:
- {先々月|せんせんげつ}: two months ago
- {先月|せんげつ}: last month
- {今月|こんげつ}: this month
- {来月|らいげつ}: next month
- {再来月|さらいげつ}: month after next

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {再来月|さらいげつ}の{初|はじ}め: early next month after
- {再来月|さらいげつ}から: from the month after next
